name: Wheat
care: Apply nitrogen in split doses; first irrigation at crown root stage (21 days).
treatment: Use resistant varieties; spray Propiconazole for rust; Imidacloprid for aphids.

name: Rice
soil: Clayey soil with good water retention
care: Transplant 25-day-old seedlings; maintain flooding; weed at 20 and 40 days.
treatment: Pheromone traps for stem borer; Tricyclazole for blast.

name: Maize
care: Earth up at knee-high stage; top-dress urea at 30 days.
treatment: Spray Emamectin benzoate in whorls; use bird perches.

name: Cotton
care: Thin plants at 15 days; remove monopodia; balanced NPK.
treatment: Pheromone traps; neem oil 5%; avoid excess nitrogen.

name: Tomato
care: Stake plants; mulch to retain moisture; prune suckers.
treatment: Mancozeb for blight; control whitefly vector; remove infected plants.

name: Sugarcane
care: Trash mulching; earthing up at 120 days; propping.
treatment: Use healthy setts; treat with Carbendazim; Chlorantraniliprole for borers.
